objective: Fetch public, no-login Canadian road-safety-assessment documents over an explicit five-host allowlist behind a robots + politeness gate, and emit git-safe evidence only: an intake manifest, a per-document download log, licence/quarantine/dedupe register rows, a train/test split file and a per-ODD-cell coverage table. Binaries and text never enter git; manifests and register rows ship.

modules.title: Robots.txt gate
modules.goal: Pure, offline-testable robots.txt parsing plus a per-path allow decision and Crawl-Delay lookup, so every Track A request is provably permitted before it is made.
modules.context: Build the only allowed src/ addition (grilling.md:60 'no src/discovery/* surgery beyond the robots helper'). Export exactly four functions: parseRobots(text): RobotsFile (pure), isAllowed(robots, path, ua): boolean, crawlDelayMs(robots, ua): number | null, robotsFor(url): Promise<RobotsFile>. robotsFor must fetch <origin>/robots.txt through withHostBudget from src/discovery/ratelimit.ts:34 (1 req/s per host), cache the result per host, and map status codes: 404/410 -> allow-all; 401/403 -> deny-all; 5xx or network error -> deny-all plus a recorded skip_reason. isAllowed must use longest-match precedence, honour User-agent group matching, and let Allow override Disallow of equal specificity. crawlDelayMs must parse Crawl-Delay (seconds -> ms) and return null when absent. Observed real-world rules that MUST be covered by fixtures (source-feasibility.md:7-10,23,26): Alberta open.alberta.ca disallows /api/, /dataset/rate/, /dataset/*/history and declares Crawl-Delay: 10; Montreal donnees.montreal.ca disallows /api/ and faceted /*?*tags= and declares Crawl-Delay: 10; BC www2.gov.bc.ca disallows /gov/search*, /search*, /en/search/, /query.html* but allows /assets/gov/...; Toronto www.toronto.ca allows * except /wp-admin/ and /legdocs/mmis/*/bgrd/; Manitoba www.gov.mb.ca disallows / for GPTBot/ClaudeBot/CCBot/Scrapy - our neutral UA is unaffected. Write a test file with no network access: fixture strings only, asserting longest-match precedence, each host fixture above, Allow-overrides-Disallow, Crawl-Delay: 10 -> 10000, and 404 -> allow-all. The test MUST NOT make an outbound request.
acceptance: src/discovery/robots.ts exports parseRobots, isAllowed, crawlDelayMs, robotsFor
robotsFor maps 404/410 -> allow-all, 401/403 -> deny-all, 5xx/network -> deny with skip_reason
isAllowed uses longest-match precedence and Allow overrides Disallow at equal specificity
crawlDelayMs returns 10000 for 'Crawl-Delay: 10' and null when absent
tests/discovery/robots.test.ts runs with no network and covers the Alberta, Montreal, BC, Toronto and Manitoba fixtures
npm run typecheck passes
out_of_scope: any other change under src/discovery/ (types.ts, ids.ts, dedupe.ts, provenance.ts)
any change under contracts/ or src/domain/
UA rotation, proxying, CAPTCHA solving, login/auth flows
per-host state files - the cache is in-memory per run

modules.title: Track A source manifest
modules.goal: Hand-authored, machine-readable source of truth for the fetch: allowlist hosts, per-source discovery strategy, licence default, and stage/province/doc_type hints.
modules.context: This file is the source list of record for D1 (grilling.md:34): allowlist = exactly five hosts - open.alberta.ca (CKAN; pin one dataset-listing URL, tolerant regex over '423 results' pagination), donnees.montreal.ca (CKAN; /dataset/<slug> pages plus /feeds/dataset.atom), www2.gov.bc.ca (sitemap at https://www2.gov.bc.ca/sitemap/sitemap_index.xml then doc pages then /assets/gov/... PDF paths - the /search* endpoints are robots-disallowed), www.unb.ca (known PDF https://www.unb.ca/research/transportation-group/_assets/documents/rsa-guidelines.pdf - no listing endpoint exists, listing untested per source-feasibility.md:16), www.toronto.ca (sitemap only; /?s= redirects to find.toronto.ca which is JS-driven and search is not usable). Dropped source families that MUST be carried in the manifest as unfillable entries with reason + family name (R12, ca-sources.md:56, source-feasibility.md:13-17): Quebec provincial www.quebec.ca (403 bot protection to our UA), open.ottawa.ca (JS-only SPA; robots 404), pub-ottawa.escribemeetings.com (JS bundle-driven, listing uncertain), Manitoba open data data.gov.mb.ca (DNS NXDOMAIN, portal retired) and www.gov.mb.ca (robots denies AI agents; use neutral UA, treat as low priority), Saskatchewan open.saskatchewan.ca (DNS NXDOMAIN) and www.saskatchewan.ca (open-data path 404), MRDC/MUNIAC www.muniac.ca (DNS NXDOMAIN, entity undefined in repo), Ottawa eScribe agenda PDFs (JS-driven). Per source record: host, family, strategy, listing_url (or null), robots_hint, licence_default verdict + basis + licence_ref, stage_hint, ca_province_hint, doc_type_hint, expected_yield_estimate. Licence defaults: Alberta = Open Government Licence - Alberta, Montreal = OGL-Quebec; fail closed to RESTRICTED for CA Crown works (grilling.md:49, probe.md:15) - only CLEAR feeds train/test. Neutral User-Agent string, no AI-agent tokens, e.g. 'AuditorAI-RSA-Harvest/1.0 (+public documents only)' (source-feasibility.md:3,27). Do not invent a §3 target list, a recovered HARVESTING_PLAN.md, or a source list beyond the five allowlisted hosts (grilling.md:59).
acceptance: File is valid JSON and contains exactly the five allowlisted hosts as fetchable entries
Every dropped source family appears as an unfillable entry with a non-empty reason and a named family
Each entry carries host, family, strategy, listing_url, licence_default, stage_hint, ca_province_hint, doc_type_hint
The UA string contains no AI-agent token (no ClaudeBot/GPTBot/CCBot/Scrapy)
No HARVESTING_PLAN.md content is fabricated; the file only encodes the ticket-list allowlist
out_of_scope: adding hosts beyond the five in grilling.md:34
retrying the dropped families (403 / DNS-dead / JS-only)
writing ODD coverage targets into the manifest - they live in state/odd-coverage.json

modules.title: Track A CLI (fetch / intake / report / selftest)
modules.goal: One script with four subcommands that runs the whole pipeline: gated fetch, intake derivation, coverage reporting and an offline self-test.
modules.context: CLI shape: tsx scripts/harvest-track-a.ts <sub> [--live] [--corpus-root <path>] [--manifest <file>]. Subcommands: fetch (network, requires --live, mirroring the dry-run write guard at scripts/discovery-run.ts:29-32), intake (no network, derives records from staged binaries), report (no network, writes coverage table + unfillable list from the intake manifest), selftest (no network, offline assertions - this is the R1 check). Export for tests: projectId, splitFor, verifyPdf, dedupeClaim, coverage. Imports from src/: withHostBudget from src/discovery/ratelimit.ts:34, sha256Hex from src/discovery/ids.ts:6, and parseRobots/isAllowed/crawlDelayMs from M1. Use the TS .js import specifier style already used by scripts/discovery-run.ts:16-18 (e.g. '../src/discovery/ratelimit.js') and run via tsx. PRJ- minting lives in the SCRIPT, not in ids.ts (grilling.md:60): format PRJ-<16 hex>, computed as sha256Hex(sourceDir + '|' + projectKey).slice(0,16), mirroring shortHash at ids.ts:16-17 and the PKG- convention at ids.ts:44-46. Split rule is one line: TEST_PROVINCES = new Set(['QC','AB']); split = TEST_PROVINCES.has(province) ? 'test' : 'train' (A2 default: AB is the held-out prairie province - the only prairie province with a live robots-clean portal; MB/SK portals are DNS-dead and MB robots bans AI agents; A3: QC = province Quebec, language is tracked separately as lang). Non-CLEAR licence verdict overrides split to 'quarantine' and is excluded from train/test (D10, R8). Per-request politeness: >=1 req/s per host via withHostBudget, >=10s between requests on the two CKAN hosts (open.alberta.ca, donnees.montreal.ca - Crawl-Delay: 10, source-feasibility.md:26), and robots evaluated per URL path, never per host (architecture report risk 2). Before writing a binary: verify %PDF- magic AND content-type; reject HTML/403 landings with a recorded reason (html-not-pdf) and write no binary. Write binaries to <corpus-root>/canada/<source-dir>/ for CLEAR and <corpus-root>/quarantine/<source-dir>/ for non-CLEAR, default corpus root docs/RSA-Documents/ (operator can point --corpus-root at the corpus box later - HITL-2). Abort/skip behaviour: robots-disallowed path -> skip + log, never fetch a variant path; JS-only listing (no server-rendered document links) -> record the source as unfillable, never drive a browser; 403 -> unfillable, no UA spoofing, no retry; DNS NXDOMAIN -> unfillable row; robots 5xx/network -> deny + skip_reason. A listing parse failure must record the source as unfillable, never crash. .gitignore: add rules for docs/RSA-Documents/canada/*/, docs/RSA-Documents/quarantine/*/ and docs/RSA-Documents/**/*.pdf, and assert afterwards that 'git status --porcelain' shows no binary path (R3). Ownership note: .gitignore lives in THIS module, not in the outputs module, because the rules must be committed before the first live fetch (deviates from architecture report section M4 grouping - sequencing requirement). Offline test file (no network) must assert: (1) split - QC->test, AB->test, BC/ON->train, train and test province sets disjoint, QC not in train, no project_id in both splits; (2) projectId stable across calls, distinct per key, matches /^PRJ-[0-9a-f]{16}$/; (3) verifyPdf accepts a %PDF- buffer and rejects a <!DOCTYPE html> buffer as html-not-pdf; (4) the log sha256 equals sha256 of the bytes; (5) a non-CLEAR doc yields split=quarantine and never train/test; (6) a new sha256 is claimed with project_id+split while a pre-existing sha256 is skipped; (7) coverage zero-fills the three canada:* cells. Do NOT touch src/discovery/ids.ts, src/discovery/types.ts, contracts/, state/odd-coverage.json or state/dedupe-index.json.
acceptance: The four subcommands exist and only 'fetch' performs network IO, and only with --live
The offline test file passes with zero network access
npx tsx scripts/harvest-track-a.ts selftest exits 0
Split rule assigns QC and AB to test, other provinces to train, and non-CLEAR to quarantine
project_id matches /^PRJ-[0-9a-f]{16}$/ and is stable for the same sourceDir+projectKey
Only %PDF- binaries with a PDF content-type are written; HTML/403 landings are rejected with a reason
CKAN hosts are requested no more than once per 10s and other hosts no more than once per second
.gitignore contains rules for the canada/ and quarantine/ corpus dirs and any PDF under docs/RSA-Documents/
git status --porcelain shows no .pdf, docs/RSA-Documents/canada/ or docs/RSA-Documents/quarantine/ path after a fetch
out_of_scope: changing state/odd-coverage.json or flipping any ODD cell status
adding corpus-schema.json fields (A7: no schema change this ticket)
running the fetch before the .gitignore rules are committed
building training packs or mining usa/ or quarantine/ for training

modules.title: Tracked outputs: intake manifest, download log, split, registers, coverage table
modules.goal: Produce the reviewable, git-safe artefact set that the PR body cites, derived mechanically from the intake manifest - never hand-edited.
modules.context: These files are written by the M2 CLI (fetch/intake/report) and committed here. Intake record shape - one JSON object per line in canada-intake-manifest.jsonl, all fields required unless noted: project_id (PRJ-<16 hex>), tier (enum T0,T1,T3,T4 - never T2, A4), stage (FEASIBILITY_CONCEPT|PRELIMINARY_DESIGN|DETAILED_DESIGN per corpus-schema.json:16), missing_side_note (string|null, values from the repo Completeness labels at src/discovery/types.ts:124-129 - no new labels), source_url (absolute), source_host (allowlisted), source_dir, track ('A'), lang (en|fr|unknown), split (train|test|quarantine), licence_verdict (CLEAR|RESTRICTED|BLOCKED per LICENSE-REGISTER.md:9-23), licence_basis, licence_ref (nullable), sha256 (64 hex = bytes), bytes, file_name, retrieved_at (ISO-8601), cell_key (canada:FEASIBILITY_CONCEPT|canada:PRELIMINARY_DESIGN|canada:DETAILED_DESIGN), ca_province (BC,AB,ON,QC,MB,NB,NL,NS,PE,SK,YT,NT,NU per corpus-schema.json:12), doc_type (guide,case-study,complete-RSA,prompt-list,policy,toolkit,presentation,correspondence per corpus-schema.json:20). A record is 'accepted' only when it carries sha256 + a licence row + a dedupe claim + a cell assignment (R4). canadian-download-log.tsv: NO header row, exactly 14 tab-separated columns in this order - source_dir, source_url, file_name, bytes, sha256, project_id, tier, stage, ca_province, lang, licence_verdict, split, cell_key, retrieved_at; row count == fetched count (R6); the sha256 column must equal 'shasum -a 256' of the file on disk. track-a-split.json: {schema_version, generated_at, rule, test_provinces:['QC','AB'], projects:[{project_id, split, provinces[], ca_province, docs, sha256[]}], assertions:{train_test_province_overlap:[], qc_in_train:false, project_in_both_splits:[]}} - the intake record stays authoritative per doc. dedupe-index.json extension: existing row shape {path, sha256, bytes, canonical_id, exact_dup_group} (dedupe-index.json:2-8) plus EXACTLY two new keys project_id and split (train|test|quarantine); append at the array end; path relative to the corpus root; canonical_id continues the C-NNNN sequence; exact_dup_group = null; the 333 pre-existing rows are read-only and never rewritten; re-serialise with JSON.stringify(rows, null, 1) (current 1-space indent) plus a trailing newline so the diff shows only appended rows. Claim only sha256 values absent from the 333 pre-existing rows; a pre-existing sha256 is skipped and reported (R9). LICENSE-REGISTER.md: one 4-column row per fetched source dir, exactly '| dir | VERDICT | basis | date |' (R7) - every fetched source dir must appear. QUARANTINE.md: one bullet per non-CLEAR document with reason and date (R8); zero non-CLEAR documents may appear in train or test. track-a-coverage.md: per canada:* cell, fetched = distinct cell_key present in the intake manifest, target = state/odd-coverage.json cells[].target (13 / 41 / 41); NEVER report the server-side have_total as fetched (ca-cells-split.md:11); flag the priority cells 0.9231 / 3 / 3; carry the section-descriptor gap as free-text priority_cell_note because rural/urban, existing/new and language are not schema axes (A7). Also emit the section 'cells Track A cannot fill': every zero-yield cell with a non-empty reason and a named source family (R12), seeded from the dropped families in M3. Report actual counts and deltas - 60-70 documents is a scale hint, not a floor (A5, D8). T1 rows are reported separately and never count as section-3 coverage. Do not hand-edit any of these files: they are regenerated by the M2 CLI.
acceptance: canada-intake-manifest.jsonl has one line per accepted document and no line with tier T2
Every manifest line has non-empty project_id, tier, stage, source_url, licence_verdict and lang
canadian-download-log.tsv has 14 tab-separated columns, no header, and row count == fetched count
The sha256 in the log equals the sha256 of the bytes on disk (spot-checked with shasum -a 256)
track-a-split.json shows train and test province sets disjoint, QC absent from train, and no project_id in both splits
dedupe-index.json contains only appended rows; the 333 pre-existing rows are unchanged; every new row carries project_id and split
Every fetched source dir has a 4-column row in LICENSE-REGISTER.md
Every non-CLEAR document has a QUARANTINE.md bullet with reason and date, and none appears in train or test
track-a-coverage.md reports fetched from distinct manifest cell_key and target from state/odd-coverage.json (13/41/41), and never uses have_total
Every zero-yield cell has a non-empty reason and a named source family
verify: python3 -c "import json;[json.loads(l) for l in open('docs/RSA-Documents/canada-intake-manifest.jsonl') if l.strip()]"
npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
out_of_scope: adding a province or language field to corpus-schema.json (A7, A9)
changing state/odd-coverage.json or flipping any cell status
state/dedupe-index.json (discovery index) - the corpus index is the claim authority; the discovery index is cross-check only (A9)
build-finetune.py marker-rule replacement (D5 says: later, once the marker rule can express geography)

integration.why: M2 and M4 both write the shared mutable register/log files, so they must run sequentially; only M1 and M3 (disjoint files: src/robots vs the source manifest) may run in parallel.
